scope: One Windows laptop/GPU, retained Native AOT workload: cumulative real-clock play, planned checkpoints and fresh-process continuation.
source_lineage: At-run measured .97 engine inputs and frozen reliability verifier; .98 is the publication checkpoint.

initial_machine.cache_state: Existing engine shader/package caches; fresh native process and cold scene upload. No cache reset.

setup_foreground_fallback.scope: Observed setup activation only; an unexercised fallback branch is not qualified.

renderer.scope: Retained .97 Vulkan raster renderer and two exact native player launches; no frame-generation or ray-tracing path.

preference_design: Warmup and cycle-one pre-save use FOV 60, UI scale 1 and gain 1. After the first Save, compiled controls set FOV 65, UI scale 1.25 and gain 0.9, retained for later soak windows. Fresh-process defaults return to 60, 1 and 1.
limits: Credited play is cumulative across planned pauses and restores, not uninterrupted thirty-minute play.
One existing workload/image/device, warm supplied content and caches. No production, clean installation or source-free export qualification.
No compatible CoreCLR script reload or scene edit/application qualification; the full Alpha reliability gate remains open.
Foreground/power are sampled; ten-second recorder windows do not cover every frame of the full session.
Present-return cadence is not scanout FPS or click-to-photon latency. CPU/GPU stages overlap and must not be summed.
Process memory covers observed play and checkpoints including planned pauses, after readiness and before final shutdown; sampled growth is not a no-leak or VRAM guarantee.
Selected current/prior diagnostic rings are bounded slow-poll observations, not full tracing or a causal stall diagnosis.
Native audio submission/driver/drain metrics are not physical listening or acoustic-quality qualification.
Exactness covers supported reflected domain state; opaque session identity alone is normalized. No hidden epochs or full internal engine-state claim.
